text:
```yaml
name: Docker Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'

jobs:
  build-and-push-docker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        run: |
          cargo build --release
          docker build -t xiangpenghao/liquid-cache:$GITHUB_REF_NAME .
          echo "${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}" | docker login -u ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }} --password-stdin
          docker push xiangpenghao/liquid-cache:$GITHUB_REF_NAME
```
